title: Effects of disability benefits on the employment of low‐skilled youth: Evidence from France
title_zh: 残疾津贴对低技能青年就业的影响：来自法国的证据
authors: Sylvain Chareyron, Naomie Mahmoudi
abstract: In this article, we assess the effect of the French disability benefits program on the employment of low‐skilled youth. Using the French Labour Force Survey, we exploit the age discontinuity in the program eligibility to instrument the effect of this allowance on employment. The results show that receipt of the French disability benefits program reduces the probability of employment for low‐skilled youth with disabilities. However, the effect differs markedly by gender: it is significantly higher for women, while no effect is detectable in men.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了法国残疾人福利计划对低技能青年就业的影响。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们借助该计划资格认定中的年龄断点，将此项津贴对就业的影响作为工具变量进行分析。结果表明，领取法国残疾人福利计划津贴会降低低技能残疾青年的就业概率。然而，该影响存在显著的性别差异：对女性的影响明显更高，而对男性则未发现显著影响。

title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据
authors: Aradhya Sood, Kevin Ehrman-Solberg
abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighborhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighborhood formation, a context characterized by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighborhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighborhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: Enforceable covenants account for 6–24% of the observed neighborhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighborhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在谢利诉克雷默案中裁定此类条款在法庭上不可强制执行，但并未完全禁止其存在。我们推测，即便失去司法强制力，这些条款仍可能通过充当社区形成初期均衡协调的焦点机制（在投资耐久性与路径依赖特征显著的背景下）影响种族隔离格局。为验证这一假说，我们构建了包含种族限制条款的新型宗地级数据集，并利用条款执行与住房建设之间的时间差设计准实验框架，以识别社区建设时期可执行条款的暴露程度。研究发现，条款的可执行性确实影响了社区形成初期的住房特征、公共基础设施布局及首批居民构成。这些早期差异展现出持久性：可执行条款可解释1980-2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离现象的6-24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1-4.4%。我们得出结论：法律通过协调社区形成过程中的信念与决策，催生了远超种族限制条款存续期的空间不平等。

title: Congestion Pricing and EMS Response Time: Evidence From New York City
title_zh: 拥堵收费与急救响应时间：来自纽约市的证据
authors: Yulia Chikish, Gregory J. Colman, Dhaval M. Dave, Brad R. Humphreys, Zachary Santamaria, Zachary Winship
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th 2025 – affects emergency medical service (EMS) response performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City's congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design applied to approximately 1.6 million EMS incidents, we find that the January 2025 implementation of congestion pricing reduced passenger vehicle traffic by roughly 21 percent near the boundary and improved total EMS travel times by 63–70 seconds, approximately 5–6 percent. Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：急救医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务响应绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界，并结合对约160万起急救医疗事件的双重断点回归设计，我们发现2025年1月实施的拥堵收费使边界附近乘用车交通量减少约21%，并将急救医疗总行程时间缩短63至70秒，降幅约为5%至6%。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域产生转移效应。纽约消防局同期发布的将患者送往最近医院的指令干扰了标准双重差分估计，但未影响我们基于边界的识别策略。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。

title: Taxing Labor: Firm R&D, Automation and the Labor Share
title_zh: 征税劳动：企业研发、自动化与劳动份额
authors: Hyejin Ku, Uta Schönberg, Ragnhild Schreiner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。

title: Are You Okay? Effects of a National Peer-Support Campaign on Mental Health
title_zh: 你还好吗？全国同伴支持运动对心理健康的影响
authors: Black, Nicole, Deer, Lachlan, S.Kunz, Johannes, Johnston, David W.
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: National public health awareness campaigns that emphasize peer-to-peer support are increasingly adopted, but evidence on the effects of peer-based programs at scale remains limited. Using quasi-experimental methods, we examine whether the prominent nationwide “R U OK? Day” campaign affects short-term mental health outcomes in Australia. Leveraging survey and administrative data, we find R U OK? Day leads to a 4% of a standard deviation increase in self-reported mental wellbeing, with the effect particularly pronounced among middle-aged males who experience a 9% of a standard deviation increase. We find no detectable effects on mental health care utilization, and we detect no statistically significant changes in suicide-related deaths in the short run, though the mortality outcomes are rare and power is limited. Our results underscore that peer-based campaigns can improve mental wellbeing, especially for high-risk groups, and point to a distinction between short-run psychological responses and outcomes that require behavioural follow-through.
abstract_zh: 强调同伴支持的国家公共卫生意识宣传活动日益普及，但关于大规模同伴项目效果的证据仍然有限。我们采用准实验方法，考察了澳大利亚全国性知名活动“你还好吗？日”对短期心理健康结果的影响。利用调查和行政数据，我们发现“你还好吗？日”使自我报告的心理健康水平提高了标准差的4%，其中中年男性的效果尤为显著，达到了标准差的9%。我们未发现该活动对心理健康服务利用产生可检测的影响，也未在短期内检测到自杀相关死亡率的统计显著变化，尽管死亡结果较为罕见且统计效力有限。我们的研究结果强调，同伴宣传活动能够改善心理健康，尤其是针对高风险群体，并指出了短期心理反应与需要行为跟进的结果之间的区别。

title: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II
title_zh: 集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶性 II
authors: Alessandro Doldi, Marco Frittelli, Marco Maggis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper complements and extends Doldi, Frittelli and Maggis, Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality, Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025), by studying collective pricing and hedging when admissible risk exchanges form a finitely generated convex cone. The collective First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing and the collective pricing-hedging duality are extended to this setting. A key contribution is a closedness result showing that no collective arbitrage implies the closedness of the aggregate feasibility cone combining infinite-dimensional trading opportunities with finite-dimensional exchanges. The paper also proves that no-collective-arbitrage prices for vectors of contingent claims form a relatively open convex set. Finally, strong collective replicability is introduced and shown to be equivalent to price uniqueness. This leads to an enhanced collective Second Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing, providing equivalent characterizations of collective completeness and strong collective completeness in terms of the uniqueness of the collective equivalent martingale measure. We highlight that several core aspects of the theory are substantially altered when exchanges belong to a convex cone rather than a vector space.
abstract_zh: 本文对Doldi、Frittelli与Maggis的《集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶》（Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025)）进行了补充与拓展，研究了当可接受风险交换构成有限生成凸锥时的集体定价与对冲问题。本文将集体资产定价第一基本定理及集体定价-对冲对偶推广至该设定。核心贡献在于一项闭性结论：无集体套利意味着聚合可行性锥的闭性，该锥结合了无限维交易机会与有限维交换。本文还证明了无集体套利条件下未定权益向量的价格构成相对开凸集。最后，本文引入强集体可复制性概念，并证明其等价于价格唯一性。由此推导出增强的集体资产定价第二基本定理，以集体等价鞅测度的唯一性为条件，给出了集体完备性与强集体完备性的等价刻画。我们强调，当交换属于凸锥而非向量空间时，该理论的若干核心方面会发生实质性改变。

title: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending
title_zh: 住宅抵押贷款中的排队、服务时间与价格动态
authors: Akos Horvath, Benjamin S. Kay
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Building on queuing theory, we develop and empirically validate a novel theoretical model of residential mortgage supply. Our model gives insight into how the stochastic arrival and sequential servicing of loan applications affect mortgage origination. The model provides closed-form predictions for lenders’ optimal response to changes in the level and price elasticity of mortgage demand. Using confidential HMDA data, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in mortgage demand raises mortgage rate spreads by 3 to 8 basis points, loan quantities by 20 to 32 percent, and application processing times by 3 to 5 days. We also provide empirical evidence for the model prediction that a higher elasticity of mortgage demand moderates price increases due to demand shocks, which can limit lenders’ exploitation of their market power.
abstract_zh: 基于排队理论，我们构建并实证验证了一个关于住宅抵押贷款供给的新型理论模型。该模型揭示了贷款申请的随机到达与顺序处理如何影响抵押贷款发放。模型为贷款机构应对抵押贷款需求水平及价格弹性变化的最优反应提供了闭式解。利用保密的HMDA数据，我们估计抵押贷款需求每增加一个标准差，抵押贷款利率价差将上升3至8个基点，贷款数量增加20%至32%，申请处理时间延长3至5天。我们还为模型预测提供了实证证据：更高的抵押贷款需求弹性会抑制需求冲击导致的价格上涨，从而限制贷款机构对其市场势力的利用。

title: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
title_zh: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据
authors: Linlin Fan, Yiwen Zhao, Andrea Carlson, Parke Wilde, Joanna Reagan, Julianna Jayne, Starr Seip, Denise Laursen, Matthew P. Rabbitt
abstract: Providing nutritious meals in institutional settings with financial constraints, such as military dining facilities, is challenging. The US Department of War (DoW) and US Department of Agriculture (USDA) collaborated to modernize the Basic Daily Food Allowance (BDFA) using an optimization model that incorporates service members' consumption patterns and nutritional standards. The model estimated optimal diets for four demographic groups, producing costs similar to the 2019 BDFA but with greater food variety. This first application of the USDA Food Plan to military purchase data demonstrates a flexible approach for improving cost estimates in military and other institutional food programs.
